summary: Jan–May 2026 yield 4.76 t/ha vs 7.87 t/ha last year (-39%); monthly crop below 1,600 t (Agro).
Main cause is a 47% drop in bunch number after the May–Jul 2025 dry spell, made worse by harvester shortage, late manuring and bagworm.
Harvesters down to 61, 17 short (Jun 2026); productivity 0.70–1.22 t/man-day.
2025: 28,188 t FFB, 18.21 t/ha vs 20.18 t/ha budget (-10%); COP RM279.52/t vs RM263.61/t budget.
2026 manuring behind (Mix A 35%, Mix B 44% to May); Ganoderma census, VOP eradication and pruning backlog still not done.

issues.title: PA says 2025 yield rose 7%; it fell
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 para 8.2 says 2025 yield (18.21 t/ha) was 7% above 2024 (18.89 t/ha). It is 3.6% lower; Agro 1/2026 Table 18 shows -3.6% and FFB fell from 29,248.13 t to 28,187.68 t.

issues.title: General charges RM/t inconsistent in PA
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 production cost table shows general charges 79.39 RM/t (budget 77.66). The PA general charges table (RM2,353,528.70 actual, RM2,551,361 budget) over 28,187.68 t actual and 31,235 t budget gives 83.50 and 81.68 RM/t. Upkeep (122.95) and harvesting (77.18) do reconcile. Using 83.50 would put COP at 283.63 rather than 279.52 RM/t.

issues.title: Palm census differs between reports
issues.detail: PA pruning table vs Agro Table 2 census: P18I 15,048 (SPH 132) vs 13,757 (SPH 120); P19J 14,280 vs 13,426; P17H 13,860 vs 13,485; P16G 17,637 vs 17,476; P09C 37,353 vs 37,283; P06B 27,468 vs 27,458. The PA table (which carries per-palm pruning rates) has 2,761 more palms.

issues.title: Harvester shortfall and requirement differ
issues.detail: PA: 72 harvesters vs 76 required (Dec 2025), 63 in Apr 2026 (short 13). Agro (Jun 2026): 61 harvesters, short 17, which implies 78 required against 76 in the PA.

issues.title: Harvester productivity figures conflict
issues.detail: PA harvesting table shows 1.50–2.25 t/man-day by block (to Dec 2025). Agro Table 9 shows 0.70–1.22 t/man-day (mean to May 2026). Agro text 4.1.10 says 0.85–1.22 but its own table lists P09C at 0.70.

issues.title: Harvesting interval: 13 days vs 15–19 days
issues.detail: PA (visit 8 Apr 2026) says the interval averaged 13 days. Agro Table 7 estate records show 15–19 days in Mar 2026 and 15–16 days in Apr 2026, with 11–15 days only from May.

issues.title: 2025 manuring 100% (PA) vs not fully done and late (Agro)
issues.detail: PA: 6,192.8 ha of 6,192.8 ha (100%), programme completed. Agro Table 3: rock phosphate/CIRP 98% (5.45 t unapplied), CRF 0% (6.56 t), with most rounds 1–4 months late (Agro 6.6b says up to five months).

issues.title: Subsurface programme cancelled vs still scheduled
issues.detail: PA 6.4.6: 2026 subsurface fertiliser programme cancelled for lack of workers. Agro revised 2026 programme (Appendix 1a, June 2026) still schedules Mix A 8 kg/palm subsurface in P06A and P06B.

issues.title: Fogging area does not add up
issues.detail: PA 6.5.3 says 4 rounds of fogging over 1,933 ha. The PA fogging table to-date column sums to 1,570.5 ha (640.8 + 404.70 + 93 + 228 + 204).

issues.title: Trunk injection chemical named differently
issues.detail: PA 6.5.2 says trunk injection used Methamidophos. Agro 4.5.9 says Monocrotophos (55%) at 10 ml/palm. The PA table lists Bullet 55 and Impact 75.

issues.title: P17H area 87.45 ha vs 93 ha
issues.detail: Agro Table 1 lists P17H as 87.45 ha (total 1,542.65 ha); the PA and the rest of the Agro report use 93 ha (total 1,548.20 ha).

issues.title: 80 ha PN25K shown as immature but not planted; clearing figures do not add up
issues.detail: PA area statement counts the 80 ha as immature (total planted 1,628.20 ha), but PA 2.2 says nothing has been planted yet and Agro 2.4 says the estate has no immature plantings. PA 2.2 says 30 ha was cleared with a 'balance of 30 ha', which totals 60 ha, not 80 ha.

actions.item: Recruit harvesters (short 17 as of Jun 2026) and lift productivity
Recruit 6 manuring workers; replace sprayers diverted to harvesting
Eradicate overgrown VOPs in P18 immediately, then other blocks
Ganoderma census and deboling of fallen palms (1.5 m cube); map infected points
Clear 95.8 ha pruning backlog in P00A, P09C, P12F; correct under-pruning in P18
Proper frond stacking and full loose fruit collection
Quarterly rat damage census in all fields
Re-block P06B2, P09C1, P11E1, P16G by end-2026
Selective palm thinning in P06, P09, P12, P16
Expedite overdue 2026 manuring (March kieserite; P11E Mix B round 2)
Fix narrow-band kieserite application; stop applying in rain
EFB in P09B at 40–50 mt/ha, one heap per four palms
Desilt drains and fix waterlogging in low-lying P12E
Verify reported weeding in P12F and do corrective spraying
Explain no bagworm follow-up in P12F and P16G since Feb 2026
Replace strip spraying with 6–8 ft circle weeding
Yearly circle raking after pruning in tall palm areas
Supply vacant points (low SPH, especially P18); PARAS drone mapping if needed
Repair 2 of 3 Badang units (battery RM3,000 each); consult Plantation Controller
Plant 80 ha PN25K when resumed, with EFB rings and Mucuna
Consider replanting P00 before 2030
Resolve cattle intrusion (court case in September)

kb:
LADANG TAGAR 3, Tagar Properties Sdn Bhd (Prosper group). Fact pack drawn from PA Report 1/2026 (Planting Advisor Mr. Boey Chee Weng, visit 8 April 2026, reviewing Jan–Dec 2025) and Agronomy Report 1/2026 (Agronomist Mr. Chong Kuan Ming, visit 17 June 2026, follow-up to 10 December 2025 visit; 2026 manuring programme). Senior Estate Manager Mr. T. Paramaswarn; Sr. Assistant Manager in charge En. Mohd Afif Bin Ramlan; Plantation Controller Dr. Chua Chin Kok (Agro).

AREA (PA, as at Dec 2025): estate title 1,685.62 ha. Mature 1,548.20 ha (91.85%), immature 80.00 ha (4.75%), total planted 1,628.20 ha (96.59%), unplanted TNB 14.00 ha, buildings/others 43.42 ha. Blocks: 00A 2000 Golden Hope/IOI 246 ha; 06B 2006 CH-DxP 204 ha; 09C 2009 278 ha; 10D 2010 22 ha; 11E 2011 217 ha; 12F 2012 137.30 ha; 16G 2016 Felda Yangambi 134.90 ha; 17H 2017 93 ha; 18I 2018 114 ha; 19J 2019 102 ha. The 80 ha ex-excavation area (PN25K) is not yet planted: 30 ha cleared, the rest on hold due to high diesel price. Agro: P00 (16% of area) is over 25 years old and replanting before 2030 should be considered; prime plantings over half the area; 7% young mature; no immature plantings. Agro Table 1 subdivides blocks (P00A1 136, P00A2 110, P06B1 84, P06B2 120, P09C1 148, P09C2 100, P11E1 129, P11E2 88, P12F1 62, P12F2 105.3, P18I1 56, P18I2 58, P19J1 53, P19J2 49) and shows P17H as 87.45 ha, total 1,542.65 ha. Re-blocking of P06B2, P09C1, P11E1 and P16G still pending; to be done by year end. For PN25K Agro recommends EFB in two rings in the circle after planting and Mucuna bracteata at 300 points/ha; planting hole CRF 600 g and RP 500 g, compound 0.8 kg, RP 1.5 kg.

PALM CENSUS (Agro Table 2, GPS census): P00A 31,864 (in progress); P06B 27,458 SPH 134; P09C 37,283 SPH 134; P10D 2,944 SPH 134; P11E 26,746 SPH 123; P12F 17,337 SPH 126; P16G 17,476 SPH 129; P17H 13,485 SPH 145; P18I 13,757 SPH 120; P19J 13,426 SPH 132. SPH lower than expected especially P18; supplying advised. PA pruning table uses higher counts (P06B 27,468; P09C 37,353; P16G 17,637; P17H 13,860; P18I 15,048; P19J 14,280).

LABOUR (PA, Dec 2025): total 115 vs 125 required (-10). Harvesters 72 vs 76 (ratio 1:22 ha vs 1:20). Manuring 13 vs 19 (-6). Sprayers 7 vs 7. Harvesting mandore 2 vs 3. Drivers/loaders 10 vs 8. Water pump attendant 1 vs 2. In April 2026 harvesters were 63 (short 13, ratio 1:25 ha); contractor to recruit 10 by May. All 7 sprayers diverted to harvesting temporarily. Worker ratio 1:13 ha. Agro (June 2026): 61 harvesters, short 17. Staff more than adequate; Field Supervisor Gobalakrishan medically boarded Nov 2025, replaced by Muhd Akif.

GENERAL CHARGES (PA, 2025): actual RM2,353,528.70 vs budget RM2,551,361 (underspent 8%); RM1,445.48/ha vs RM1,566.98/ha. Management RM792,195.56; labour and amenities RM457,308.38; other expenditure RM1,091,455.76 (over budget RM991,831): electricity +76% (TNB tariff), water +18% (water carted from Berjaya Estate for 2 weeks after mill effluent polluted reservoir), recruitment +37% (19 workers recruited vs 8 budgeted), security +8%. MSPO RM12,569.

UPKEEP AND CULTIVATION (PA, 2025): total RM3,465,662 vs RM3,422,844 (overspent 1%); RM2,238.51/ha vs RM2,210.82/ha. Per ha actual vs budget: weeding 214.27 vs 220.84; manuring 1,650.84 vs 1,602.66; pest and disease 152.79 vs 74.02; census and thinning 8.31 vs 4.96; drains 1.12 vs 25.80; roads and bridges 97.49 vs 138.34; boundaries 0.23 vs 3.38; soil/water conservation 0.87 vs 23.35; pruning 112.59 vs 117.47.

WEEDING: PA circle spraying 4,484.71 ha (2.9 rounds), 93% of 4,826 ha; CDA output 7 ha/man-day, RM13/ha, earnings RM91/day, glyphosate 0.49 l/ha. Selective spraying 4,644.60 ha, 96%; mist blower 6.5 ha/man-day, RM15/ha, RM97.50/day, Garlon 0.49 l/ha. VOPs prevalent, very bad in P18 (6+ years old, bearing bunches). Agro: 2025 three rounds done except final circle rounds in P00 and P06 partial; 2026 first round done except P09C, second round started May. Clidemia patches in P09 and P12; P12F overgrown despite records; VOPs in circles in P00, P06, P09, P11, P12; strip spraying is against company policy, use 6–8 ft circles.

MANURING: PA: 6,192.8 ha, 100% of budget in 2025; broadcasting 22 bags/man-day, RM17/ha, RM68/day; mini dumpers abandoned; subsurface at P06B only 13 bags/man-day, 0.5 ha/day, RM90/ha, RM45/day (basic wage RM65.38); 2026 subsurface cancelled. Agro Table 3 (2025): Mix A 369.25 t 100%; Mix B 1,119.00 t 100%; NK1 191.25 t 100%; kieserite 78.25 t 100%; CIRP 290.35 of 295.80 t (98%); CRF 0% (6.56 t unapplied, for PN25K). Rounds 1–4 months late. Agro Table 5 (2026 to May): Mix A 129.75 of 369.30 t (35%); Mix B 367.45 of 843.80 t (44%); NK2 79.65 t (100%); kieserite, RP, compound 0%. Delays due to late deliveries; March kieserite not applied in P09C, P12F, P16G, P17H, P18I, P19J; P11E Mix B round 2 overdue. Kieserite applied in rain and in narrow bands in P16. EFB in P09B excessive; use 40–50 mt/ha. 2026 programme revised for second half due to fertiliser price hike and limited stock.

PEST AND DISEASE: PA: rat baiting (Storm) where damage above 10%. Bagworm high in 2025; trunk injection over 1,010.33 ha and fogging (PA says 4 rounds over 1,933 ha). Ganoderma widespread with fruiting bodies; census and deboling needed. Cattle intrusion unresolved; court case in September. Agro: rat census irregular; not done in P00A, P06B, P09C, P10D, P16G in 2026; P17H 35% (Apr) and 31% (May). P18I 19% to 2%, P19J 15% to 9% after Feb 2026 baiting. Bagworm (Metisa plana) significant in P11E, P12F, P16G, P17H; P18I 20% and P19J 26% in May 2026; monocrotophos trunk injection P11 Jan–Feb, lambda-cyhalothrin fogging P17H; prefer Bt when low. Ganoderma in P00, P09, P10, P12; no deboling progress.

HARVESTING (PA, 2025): cost RM2,175,445 = RM77.18/t vs RM76.36/t budget (top-up wages RM55,184 for new harvesters). Rounds 21.4 vs 24 budget. Interval averaged 13 days. Outturn 94%. 2 of 3 Badang units down (battery RM3,000 each). Block rates and output: P00A RM52/t 1.60 t; P06B RM37 1.80 t; P09C RM34 1.50 t; P10D RM34 2.00 t; P11E RM34 1.50 t; P12F RM33 1.50 t; P16G RM30 2.25 t; P17H RM32 1.80 t; P18I RM50 2.00 t; P19J RM60 2.00 t. Low-output harvesters work about 5.5 hours/day. Agro: intervals 14–21 days Jan–Apr 2026, 11–15 in May; over-ripe bunches above 5% in P06B and P12F; productivity 0.70–1.22 t/man-day to May 2026.

CROP (PA, 2025): FFB 28,187.68 t vs budget 31,235 t; 2024 29,248.13 t. Yield 18.21 t/ha vs 20.18 budget (10% below) and 18.89 in 2024. CPO 5,272.77 t, OER 18.71% vs 19.00%; kernel 1,409.39 t, 5.00%. Agro Table 18 block yields 2025 (2024): P00A 18.17 (17.44); P06B 20.13 (19.85); P09C 16.00 (19.42); P10D 26.00 (25.29); P11E 15.35 (15.13); P12F 15.67 (19.23); P16G 23.51 (24.32); P17H 19.72 (20.30); P18I 16.66 (15.34); P19J 21.62 (20.71). Agro monthly FFB 2026: Jan 1,551.33; Feb 1,275.21; Mar 1,446.46; Apr 1,577.19; May 1,525.03; total 7,375.22 t. Estate yield Jan–May 2026 4.76 vs 7.87 t/ha (-39.4%). Bunch number down 47.2% (901,007 to 476,110); average bunch weight up 14.6% (13.52 to 15.49 kg). Causes: May–July 2025 dry spell (98.0, 124.0, 35.5 mm), incomplete crop recovery, manuring delays, bagworm 2024/25. Crop expected to improve later in 2026.

PRODUCTION COST (PA, 2025): RM279.52/t FFB vs RM263.61 budget (general 79.39 vs 77.66; upkeep 122.95 vs 109.58; harvesting 77.18 vs 76.37); RM1,494.25/t CPO vs RM1,387.60. High due to low yield.

OTHER (PA): roads graded 4,620.35 of 6,513 chains at RM12.50/chain, suspended due to diesel cost; crusher run 348 of 670 t at RM43/t. No drain desilting (RM1,733 spent on backhoe clearing). Pruning 9,279 of 9,289 ha; RM1.20/palm/yr (2000), RM1.00 (2006), RM0.80 (2009–2019). Capex RM10,290 vs RM133,000.

RAINFALL (Agro): 2021 2,901.0 mm/132 days; 2022 2,950.5/160; 2023 2,740.95/177; 2024 2,436.75/189; 2025 2,477.1/148.

2026 FERTILISER PROGRAMME (Agro Appendix 1, revised, kg/palm): P00A and P00B NK2 2.50 in Feb (to be withdrawn if replanting in 2026/2027). P06B Mix A 8.00 subsurface in Jan and P06A in Feb (4 holes at 2 kg/hole). P09A and P09B Mix A 2.25 (Jan), Mix B 2.00 (Apr), Mix A 2.25 (Aug). P10C, P11A, P11C Mix B 2.25 in Jan, Apr and Aug. P12B, P12D, P12E Mix B 2.25 plus kieserite 0.75 in Jan, Mix B 2.25 in Apr and Aug. P16, P17, P18 Mix B 2.25 (Feb), kieserite 0.75 (Mar), Mix B 2.25 (May), Mix B 1.50 (Aug), RP 1.50 (Sep), Mix B 1.50 (Nov). P19 the same but kieserite 0.50 and May Mix B 2.00. Mixture A is 45% AS, 40% MOP, 15% kieserite; Mixture B is 45% AS, 40% MOP, 14% kieserite, 1% borate; NK2 is 60% SOA, 40% MOP; compound 14:13:9:2.5. The 2027 programme will be drawn up in the second half of 2026.

AGRO PRUNING AND PALM CONDITION: 95.8 ha of pruning pending in P00A, P09C and P12F as of May 2026. Ravine palms are left unattended because of palm height. An extra contractor with 6 workers was engaged, and the backlog should clear in two months. Progressive pruning is consistent in P06B and P10D. There is slight under-pruning in P11A, P16 and P17. Frond stacking in terraced areas is still poor. Selective thinning in P06, P09, P12 and P16 is still pending. Leaf sampling in June 2025 showed major nutrients down on the previous sampling; leaves will be re-sampled in 2026. Chlorotic fronds were seen in the ravines of P12 and P00. For young mature P18 and P19, the reported pruning is over 95% complete. P18 weeding: 2 inter-row and 1 circle round to May 2026. P19: 2 circle and 1 inter-row round. P19 Clidemia and wild brinjal have improved.

PA BUNCH WEIGHTS (Dec 2024 to Dec 2025): 2000 23.0 to 22.1 kg; 2006 22.0 to 22.3; 2009 21.0 to 21.5; 2010 21.0 to 20.8; 2011 20.0 to 20.5; 2012 21.0 to 20.3; 2016 13.0 to 13.6; 2017 9.0 to 10.2; 2018 6.0 to 6.0; 2019 4.0 to 5.4 kg. Overripe bunches from extended intervals were noted. Vehicles: the ambulance ran 5,668 of 10,000 km (grossly underused). Tractors BPD 1246 and BPJ 4895 ran 1,468 and 1,532 of 2,200 hours (low because the PN25K planting was deferred). Manual loading: Div A 18 t/day and Div B 16 t/day at RM7.50/t.

DATA CAVEATS: PA 8.2 states 2025 yield was 7% above 2024, but the figures (18.21 vs 18.89 t/ha) show a 3.6% fall. The PA general charges RM/t (79.39) does not reconcile to its RM table (83.50 implied). Harvester counts, productivity, harvesting intervals and palm census differ between the two reports; see issues.

notes: Harvest items are RM/t as printed (s.7); upkeep and general-charges items computed as RM amount / 28,187.68 t actual and 31,235 t budget (calc).

MISMATCH general charges: printed group RM/t 79.39 actual / 77.66 budget, but sub-items (RM 2,353,528.70 / 28,187.68 t) sum to 83.49 / 81.68 (about 5% higher). Group totals kept as printed in s.9 (match dashboard costParts); the report's implied tonnage (about 29,645 t) is unexplained. General-charges items therefore do not add to the group total.
Upkeep items sum to 122.94 / 109.60 vs printed 122.95 / 109.58 (rounding).
Harvest budget items sum to 76.36 vs 76.37 printed in s.9 (s.7 itself prints 76.36). External transport nil; top-up wages unbudgeted.

ffbProd.notes: No PA Report 2/2026 exists in the folder yet (latest PA is 1/2026, visit 8 Apr 2026), so 2026 data comes only from Agronomy 1/2026 (Jan-May). No Jun 2026 figure. Area basis is mature 1,548.20 ha throughout (PN25K 80 ha ex-excavation block is unplanted). 2022 caveat: printed 2022 total 20,868.10 t (sum of the printed monthly figures) does not reconcile with the 14.36 t/ha 2022 yield printed in Agro 1/2024 Table 12 (20,868.10 / 1,548.20 = 13.48 t/ha; 14.36 t/ha corresponds to roughly 22.2k t, and Table 13 bunch count x ABW is of similar order). Used the printed tonnage total; treat 2022 with caution. 2021 and earlier tonnages are not printed in the folder reports. Nov 2024 todate 26,831.31 (PA 1/2025 visit 2-2024) + Dec 2,416.82 = 29,248.13, consistent. PA 1/2026 para 8.2 says 2025 yield was 7% above 2024, but figures show 28,187.68 vs 29,248.13 (a 3.6% fall), as Agro states.
